question: Find ALL flip points (pass<->fail) of test.detcore_misc's vfork::vfork_parent_resumes_after_child_exec across hermit commit history, using load-amplified concurrent-stress probes with rate-based (trinary) classification.

probe.design: matched-load co-scheduling; N single-shot instances of every commit launched interleaved per wave so all share instantaneous host load; head co-scheduled as validity calibrator (wave valid only if head FLAKY); trinary PASS(all-pass)/FAIL(zero-pass)/FLAKY(mixed), FLAKY=RED.
probe.calibration: head 30x@load407: 5/5 waves FLAKY; head co-scheduled FLAKY in every counted wave

signature_confirmed_at_head.stack: ptrace -> Stopped::getevent -> Event::decode_status_return -> WaitFuture::poll -> Running::next_state -> Zombie::reap, under reverie_ptrace::task::handle_internal_error

root_cause: Long-standing reverie safeptrace notifier bug: decode_status_return does `?` (return Err(Died) on ESRCH) BEFORE reservation.commit(), so the dead status is never popped from `pending` and is re-getevent'd forever = ESRCH hot spin. Latent since 2021; the notifier ~10x slowdown pulled by reverie a8195cf (capture_identity) widened the waitid->getevent death-race window enough to expose it under concurrency. Fix = reverie PR #355 (820b2b64), not yet pinned at hermit main.
